reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the ductility limitation by proposing a phase inversion to a ductile BCC matrix with discrete B2 precipitates, a mechanism physically sound for BCC+B2 refractory alloys and supported by cited evidence (E1, E3) on the same alloy class. It is specific, testable, and grounded, whereas Hypothesis B relies on nanoprecipitate strengthening from a different alloy system (W-based with Ni/Fe/Ta) not shown to work in NbMoTaW, and its mechanism for improving ductility is less convincing for this inherently brittle BCC alloy.
